findings.summary: The 2010 Karnes IGSA priced the first 480 detainees at $68.75 and detainees 481-600 at $56.48; Article III separately called 480 the minimum bed availability and limited liability to actual detainee days, while Article I made the start of minimum payments dependent on Attachment 7.

evidence.quote: Bed Day Rate – per detainee for the first 480 $ 68.75 per detainee; Bed Day Rate – per detainee for the 481-600 $ 56.48 per detainee. The attached Ramp-Up plan (Attachment (7)) indicates when ICE is required to start paying at the minimum requirements.

The Service Provider shall provide male beds on a space available basis, with minimum availability of 480 beds. ICE will be financially liable only for the actual detainee days as defined in Paragraph C of Article III.

findings.summary: A 2009 GEO task-order modification labeled 1,146 adult detainees as guaranteed housing and a separate above-guarantee tier as 758 maximum.

evidence.quote: ADULT DETAINEES 1146 GUARANTEED HOUSING; ADULT DETAINEES ABOVE GUARANTEED MINIMUM 758 MAX

findings.summary: The Pearsall performance work statement required staffing for an estimated 1,000 adults and 20 juveniles and at least five female officers per shift excluding transportation.

evidence.quote: Base year adult male detainees - 850 beds; Base Year Adult female detainees - 150 beds; Juveniles 20 beds.

The contractor shall, at all times, staff the facility to accommodate the estimated population of 1000 adult and 20 juvenile detainees. The contractor shall provide a minimum of five (5) female officers per shift excluding transportation.

findings.summary: GEO states that it provides ICE support services at the Karnes Center under an IGSA between Karnes County and ICE.

evidence.quote: GEO provides support services for ICE at the Karnes Center under an IGSA between Karnes County and ICE, that is effective through August 2029.

findings.summary: A single GEO/ICE modification under ACD-4-C-0001 and HSCEDM-09-F-00001 uses ‘South Texas Detention Cent’ in its funding-purpose text and ‘SOUTHWEST TEXAS DETENTION COMPLEX’ for the continuation-sheet delivery location at 566 Veterans Drive, Pearsall, supporting that the names are variants for the same contracted facility.

evidence.quote: MODIFICATION OF CONTRACT/ORDER NO. ACD-4-C-0001 / HSCEDM-09-F-00001. The purpose of this modification is to provide funding for the South Texas Detention Cent ... Delivery Location Code: DROPEARSALL / SOUTHWEST TEXAS DETENTION COMPLEX / 566 VETERAN'S DRIVE / PEARSALL TX 78061 USA.
